ideas.label: Maróczy Bind
ideas.principle: Convert space by maintaining the bind
ideas.summary: The Maróczy Bind uses central pawns to restrict freeing breaks and limit opposing pieces. Its owner should improve patiently without loosening the bind.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
Folin, Giorgio vs Picone Chiodo, Luigi 2026 (B70)
source_books: Grandmaster Repertoire 5: The English Opening - Volume Three

ideas.label: Maróczy Bind
ideas.principle: Control the breaks that challenge the bind
ideas.summary: The cramped side seeks timely pawn breaks and piece exchanges; the side with the Maróczy Bind controls those breaks and targets backward pawns created by the compact setup.
games: Folin, Giorgio vs Picone Chiodo, Luigi 2026
Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Grandmaster Repertoire 5: The English Opening - Volume Three

ideas.label: Maróczy Bind
ideas.principle: Coordinate the bind against the freeing break
ideas.summary: A knight reroute toward a stable queenside or central square can reinforce the Maróczy Bind while freeing heavier pieces. Before allowing the opponent's f-pawn break, calculate whether the opened diagonal activates the Dragon bishop or merely leaves lasting weaknesses.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Grandmaster Repertoire 5: The English Opening - Volume Three
